column1: POST-RUN verification (not part of the VM campaign). No model was loaded; files were only hashed (SHA-256, read-only on the VM folder).
Each stage marker (stage_markers/*.ok) of the deadline-v1 campaign records a SHA-256 for its output files. For every recorded output that exists in the VM folder,
the file was hashed directly and compared. The two ckpt/latest.json hashes (epoch_025.pt of V1 and V3) were compared the same way.
Paths are relative to artifacts/m2-deadline-v1/ in the VM folder IOT-network-traffic-DL-M2-VM-deadline-v1. This check needs that VM folder; a teammate without it cannot repeat it.
Result: 59 hashes compared, 59 MATCH, 0 MISMATCH, 0 not found.
